mechanism_narrative: A sustained 1-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 1-month decline exceeding 0.5% in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in interaction-triggered instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 1-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of HOUST increase are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 270.0 as of t-1mo signals inflationary pressures that lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 50% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL > 270.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 1-month decline exceeding 0.5% in employment (PAYEMS) and rise exceeding 0.1% in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in interaction-triggered instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% YoY), a slowdown in GDP growth (as measured by the 1-quarter change in GDPC1) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 55% of triggered instances despite GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
